question: After directional breadth has expanded by at least two percentage points, can rejecting K1 bars already more than 0.75ATR beyond SMA34 improve the probability of a genuine daily trend takeover without loosening the sparse K1->K2 episode?
hypothesis: A K1 that has crossed EMA13 but remains within 0.75ATR of SMA34 is earlier in the launch. A farther K1 is more likely to be a late chase whose K2 retest has poor remaining right tail.
single_variable_contract: Relative to frozen V3, only k1_signed_slow_side_atr_max=0.75 is added. Breadth, EMA13/SMA34, compression episode, K1/K2 morphology, votes, gap, entry, stops, bank schedule, runner, horizon, costs and portfolio risk cannot change after holdout opens.
discovery_bias: Both the variable and 0.75 threshold were chosen after inspecting V3 development and confirmation A. Those rows are discovery only. The authorized 2026-05-04 through 2026-08-31 holdout is the sole final test for this exact configuration.

holdout_accounting.owner_authorization: The owner explicitly approved reading prices after 2026-05-04 and later authorized autonomous execution.

controls: Two deterministic random entries per candidate, matched on symbol, half-year, copied direction and within-symbol holdout ATR14 quintile, with identical risk, exit and 20bp cost.
decision_rule: Every registered gate is conjunctive. Failure of any gate rejects V4. Passing all gates would create only a research/paper candidate because P0/P1, current-universe survivorship and production gates remain unresolved.
sealed_data: The 108-symbol V3 confirmation B partition remains unopened and is not used for warmup, breadth, signals, outcomes or controls.
forbidden_after_open: change K1/K2 morphology, MA lengths or vote count
change stop, take-profit, runner, cost, sizing or acceptance gates
write TradingView, ACTIVE, forward, deployment or live-order state
